reels.title: The 18 planetary hours
reels.hook: Your day isn't one mood. It's 18.
beats: Most apps: one reading for 24 hours
Each hora has its own texture

reels.voiceover: Across your day, some horas are clearer for a task and some feel heavier. The Jupiter hora leans toward growth, the Mercury hora toward being understood. We map them in plain English so you can plan on purpose.

reels.title: Sade Sati is not a curse
reels.hook: People call Sade Sati a curse. It isn't.
reels.voiceover: Sade Sati is Saturn's roughly seven and a half year passage over your Moon. It's better understood as a teacher than a punishment, and knowing your phase helps you work with it, in plain English.
